name: IndiGo

snapshot.about: India's leading airline providing domestic and international air travel services.

narrative: Management delivered on passenger unit revenue in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, beating its mid-teens guidance with nineteen point nine percent growth and matching capacity growth guidance at three percent. However, third-quarter capacity missed high-teens targets at eleven percent.

bull.point: Passenger unit revenue grew nineteen point nine percent in the first quarter of fiscal 2027, comfortably exceeding management guidance of mid-teens growth.

bull.point: Cash generation remains robust, with cumulative five-year operating cash flow far exceeding reported net profits.
